text:
Avery (PM): quick question — we need to pick which infra-facing work to prioritize next sprint. Q: do we do infra batching optimizations (high effort, high cost savings) or finish the lightweight routing fallback for Dedicated (low effort, high impact for customers)?
Diego (Eng): batching is a multi-week lift. depends if we take on kernel work or config-layer changes.
Rina (EM): can we break batching into a narrow MVP that gives 30% perf gains? that would reduce risk and allow parallel work.
Sam (Dir Product): what's the RICE for both? impact and reach for routing fallback vs batching?
Avery (PM): rough calc — routing fallback: Reach=70 (percentage of Dedicated customers), Impact=6 (reduces p99 failures/retries), Confidence=80, Effort=2 (1 sprint). RICE ~= (70*6*0.8)/2 = 168.
Diego (Eng): batching MVP: Reach=40 (applies to high-QPS tenants), Impact=8, Confidence=50, Effort=6 (3 sprints). RICE ~= (40*8*0.5)/6 = 26.7
Lina (SRE): operationally, routing fallback reduces incident surface immediately. batching reduces cost long-term but increases complexity (KV cache correctness).
Kai (Sales): routing fallback unlocks at-risk deals for two finance customers asking for deterministic failover. they need it before EoQ.
Rina (EM): constraint: docs + customer config schema must be ready for routing change. Docs team is +1 FTE this sprint only. if we shift, docs will be overloaded.
Avery (PM): tradeoff: routing gives immediate revenue protection + lower incident load; batching gives 20-30% token cost reduction across host but long ramp and infra risk.
Sam (Dir Product): recommendation: ship routing fallback first as a scoped feature (canary + flag), run canary for 2 weeks, then allocate 50% of infra team to batching spike.
Diego (Eng): need to sequence: (1) gated canary for routing (SRE + infra config), (2) docs & support playbook, (3) batching spike then decide. estimated timeline: routing MVP in 2 sprints if docs slot is reserved.
Avery (PM): launch criteria for routing fallback: automated canary running 2000 reqs/h, zero increase in error budget, roll-forward plan, and docs + customer-facing notes.
Lina (SRE): add rollback playbook + synthetic load test in staging.
Kai (Sales): pls mark customers A/B who need early access, I'll coordinate comms.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: routing-fallback/v1 -> staging at 1743362000 by @deploy-bot
Diego (Eng): one more constraint — Dedicated capacity team has a planned maintenance in sprint 2 that will limit deploys. may push routing by 3 days.
Avery (PM): ok — decisions: prioritize routing fallback this sprint, scope it minimal, reserve docs slot, schedule batching spike in week 3. I'll update roadmap and queue. :thumbsup:
Rina (EM): will break routing into three tickets: canary infra, feature flag + config, docs + support. assigning in retro.
Sam (Dir Product): thank you — please add the RICE calcs to the ticket. we'll review if new customer asks change numbers.
Diego (Eng): noted. starting a quick design thread in eng-platform.
Avery (PM): closing loop — I'll create a follow-up thread for cross-team resourcing and post the final prioritized list.
